description: Non-major devDependency updates and non-major, non-0.x production updates are committed straight to the default branch once their check runs are green.
Majors, 0.x production dependencies, GitHub Actions and security fixes keep the usual pull-request flow.

packageRules.description: Merge non-major devDependencies on green CI, no pull request.
Merge non-major, non-0.x production dependencies on green CI, no pull request.
